title: ASTM C 636, Section 2.
officialText:
1.4. Delete Section 2.1.4 and replace as follows:
2.1.4 Hangers shall be designed to support the suspended loads and shall be a minimum ¼ inch (6.4mm) diameter galvanized steel
rods or 1 inch× 1/8 inch thick (25 mm × 3.2 mm) flat steel bars. The use of steel wire as a hanger shall not be permitted.
